recorded_static_checks.description: The G33 allowlist file was read and its raw SHA-256 was computed with a non-Git tool; it equals 92a8e111f277be8bb35f2f67944306e20365ef65d17544e55c073a9b0ffbbdd1. The focused test hard-binds that value, and the allowlist was not modified.

Only the three G33 documentation artifacts, XFR-D-024 v1.1 and the six named G32 structural examples were content-reviewed as implementation sources. No unlisted production source file was content-reviewed or modified. The existing package metadata was used only by npm to invoke the authorized typecheck and was not manually inspected or modified.
The allowlist declares exactly nine paths: three present documentation artifacts and six planned code, test and verification artifacts.

Exactly the six planned allowlisted paths were created: the standalone HTML page, the scenario module, the component, the entry module, the focused test and this verification record. Each path was confirmed absent immediately before creation (non-Git path-existence check). No pre-existing file was modified and no path outside the allowlist was created.

The scenario reproduces the allowlist html_title, the three always-visible lines, the six regions in order, all twelve matrix row identifiers and their frozen boundary strings, the terminal token and the terminal line as byte-identical strings. The eleven open exact-content categories are rendered as readable statements that are one-to-one content-aligned with the condensed allowlist identifiers; the focused test asserts the count is 11. The ordering/input-separation, non-compensation, fail-closed/evidence and independence-preserved lists carry the asserted content.

The static markup contains exactly one main, one h1, six sections and one twelve-row table, with zero controls, links, live regions, mutable state, network, persistence, telemetry, timers, randomness, person/property/business data, automatic action or menu/router exposure. The authored modules contain no state hooks, event handlers, fetch, storage, cookies, console logging, timers, Math.random, animation or transition.

limitations: The full web regression suite was not executed in this code phase; only the focused G33 test file and the web typecheck were executed.
No live browser render at the authorized dev URL was performed, so layout beyond the asserted static markup is unverified.
The verification record does not contain its own SHA-256 because a file cannot contain its own hash.
The focused test compares the open exact-content categories by count rather than exact sentence text, because the allowlist records them as condensed identifiers.
No Git command of any kind was executed in this code phase; path existence, allowlist hash binding and file creation were confirmed with non-Git tooling only.
This record asserts creation-time static facts only; it makes no mathematical, statistical, production, runtime or implementation claim.
